patterns.what_worked: Treating the filed corpus as a claim-list and re-deriving each claim against three independent source classes (the shipped tree, the client source of five branches in /home/sam/wow-ui-source, and live sim/web sources) turned four 'no honest probe exists' filings into concrete build specs, and caught a swapped id pair in the corpus itself (TBC 26862 = Sinister Strike, 26864 = Hemorrhage).
patterns.what_was_hard: Proving a NEGATIVE (that no source can exist) is expensive: the rage-regeneration and Chain-Lightning-enemy-count items each needed three sim/client fetches before the 'impossible to cite' conclusion was defensible. Counting rows accurately across five differently-shaped tables also took several passes.
patterns.skill_gap: The GitHub contents API returns raw JSON through this harness, so a 'list only the names' prompt does not actually shrink the payload; the tree API and raw-file fetches are cheaper for path discovery.
